name: Cha oc
summary: Chả ốc is the finished dish of a black apple-snail farm. The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s 2024 note, by Thanh Hương, places the farm in xã Duy Phú. The caption calls chả ốc the product of that model. It does not describe the cake.
origin: Xã Duy Phú, in the Da Nang Fatherland Front note for 2024.
howToEat: The note does not say how the cake is cooked or what it is eaten with. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Xã Duy Phú. The note names the farm and does not name a restaurant. Check on arrival for a door.
seoTitle: Cha oc — snail cake from a Duy Phu farm
seoDescription: The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s 2024 note calls chả ốc the product of a black apple-snail farm in Duy Phú. No method and no price were printed.
